answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting/grading, every identity must deposit 500 USDC into the Lotus staking contract and bind a unique Ripple keypair. A farm of 1000 clones pays 500,000 USDC and loses it all when the audit detects the clone pattern; the slasher emits an Ember event and revokes the staked identity. Honesty stays cheaper.
